one_liner: Devin has a documented v3 REST API (sessions, playbooks, knowledge, enterprise) using cog_ bearer tokens and an official vendor-hosted MCP server at mcp.devin.ai. Whether the Free plan includes API access is unconfirmed, so a paid plan is still assumed.
auth_notes: Service user API keys and personal access tokens, both cog_-prefixed bearer tokens. No OAuth2 app flow is documented for the API. Legacy apk_ keys are deprecated and only work with the repository documentation tools of the MCP server.
access_notes: Self-serve plans are Free, Pro, Max and Teams. The MCP docs say to sign up for a Devin account and generate an API key from account settings, but the fetched pages do not say which plan tier includes API access. The draft's paid-plan assumption is kept and not confirmed. Enterprise deployments use a custom API domain.
blocker_notes: The builder may need a paid plan to get API credentials. This is unconfirmed, because the pages only say to sign up for a Devin account and generate an API key. Multi-user access relies on per-user PATs or service keys, not OAuth.

evidence.quote: All API credentials use the `cog_` prefix format. Include your token in the `Authorization` header of every request
Personal Access Tokens (PATs) allow human users to authenticate programmatically under their own identity.
The Free plan lets you try Devin with limited usage. It includes: - Limited Devin usage - Access to [Devin Review](/work-with-devin/devin-review)
1. Sign up for a Devin account at [Devin.ai](https://devin.ai/)
The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
The Devin MCP server is an authenticated service that provides access to both public and private repositories, plus full platform management capabilities. **Base Server URL:** `https://mcp.devin.ai/`
